why: Issue #3956 ranked target scripts/langchain/followup_issue_generator.py is already at 100% line+branch coverage. Remaining incomplete keepalive checkboxes were the numbered coverage-contract items (1-5). PR-meta refresh normalised those issue lines to '1. [ ] ...' but parseCheckboxStates/mergeCheckboxStates only handled dash bullets, so checked contract state was dropped on every Upsert PR body sections run and keepalive never stood down. Minimal production fix restores numbered checklist durability.
